	FIELD TITLE string
		REQUIRED
	FIELD STATUS todo|implemented
		REQUIRED
	FIELD MILESTONE @MILESTONE
	FIELD AFTER @TASK
		REPEATABLE

SCHEMA MILESTONE
	DESC "the tasks planned for one request"
	FIELD TITLE string
		REQUIRED
	FIELD STATUS planned|running
		REQUIRED

	FIELD STATUS open|closed
		REQUIRED
	FIELD BLOCKS @TASK
		REPEATABLE
		CONVERSE BLOCKED_BY
	WHEN STATUS closed
		GATE suppressed
